A level_up event could NOT reach a trace on any build: it is emitted from _applyUIPending() on a PAUSED frame (S14 stops the world outside a fight while a screen is open) and _afterStep() returned before writing a record; stepOnce() then clears the bus at the top of the next unpaused step. _afterStep() now writes one record for a paused frame that actually emitted something.
sim.frame does not advance while a menu is open, so a multi-frame queueInputs script never fires — each press has to be its own one-frame script.
getPlayerStats() had no soulsToNextLevel and no soulsSpent; added.
